page.layout: One page of text in one column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Nothing in the margins. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: rer grösse halben in der Figur nit hat herbey
Reimen/ Lobspruch und Materien / wie sol-
che derselben / ein jedes an seinem Ort
Nun erstlich so stehet zu oberst am
unter dem tabernaculo mystico seu hierogy-
phico, zwischen den beyden vorhergehender be-
grosse Feldung / welche den Titel und Dedica-
tion deß gantzen Werckes mit einer scheinbaren
licher Königreich Königen vñ Erben/ Ertz-
hertzogen zu Oesterreich/ Hertzogen zu Bur-
thumben und Landen in Europa &c. zu lob

page.notes: A stray glyph (a large capital-like mark) stands at the left of the last line before the catchword; not transcribed. The word "hierogyphico" is split at the line end with a stroke over the y; read as "hierogy-phico". The word "vñ" with a tilde is copied as printed. Printed hyphen at "Ertz-" and "Fürsten-" line ends is not clearly visible, so those words are written whole. The opening lines are set in larger type and are treated as a heading.
